text:
julie: Heads-up: got a support ticket — tenant reported a sudden billing blip right when they upgraded to our websocket preview. Their console shows a 4x token burn in first 15s.

nilesh: Oof. Any traces? could be double-send on initial frames or proxy replays.

dena: I pulled logs, saw repeated "session.init" events with slightly different session_ids (session_id v1 and v1-1) within 200ms. Looks like proxy retransmit + router rewrite.

max: Interesting. Ingest-bot shows two inbound SYNs -> we then accepted both and spun up two worker allocations. That would double-meter.

ingest-bot: Ingest log: duplicate_connect_detected session_id=abc123 duplicate_of=abc123-1 proxied_by=gw-edge-7 attempts=2

julie: Is the duplicate from the client or our edge? Client says single connect. Maybe TCP fast-retry from an intermediate LB?

nilesh: We changed edge keepalive and early-close knobs last week (cf. PR #402). Could be the proxy now ACKs late causing client to retransmit.

dena: Screenshot of their console: Billing panel shows 'burst tokens: 2.1k' and next line 'warmup-credit applied: -1.05k' -> net still shows big usage. Customers are confused.

max: Worst part: our alerting fired "token_rate > X for 1m" and on-call paged SRE. This is noisy. We should suppress alerts for burst patterns matching duplicate_connect_detected tag.

julie: Agreed. Short-term mitigation: add a server-side dedupe on session init idempotency for 1s window. If we see same client_id+fingerprint, drop second worker spawn and mark as deduped in logs.

nilesh: I can throw a lightweight guard in router: check for recent session init hashes and return a 204 early to the duplicate. Will that stop metering?

max: Metering happens downstream in billing-service when worker registers the session. We need to ensure billing ignores sessions marked deduped=true. That means an ingestion tag must be propagated.

dena: Short plan: (A) router dedupe (nilesh), (B) worker registration includes "deduped=true" flag if router rejected, (C) billing ignores deduped registrations for first 5s, (D) Console shows a note "duplicate connection suppressed" in usage detail.

julie: Timeline? Customer impacted is small but vocal. We should hotfix canary tonight.

nilesh: I have a 30-min patch for router dedupe and the gateway config. Pushing to canary now.

ingest-bot: Canary patch deployed on gw-edge fleet (8 nodes). health=ok

max: I'll add billing guard: registration proto change is tiny, add deduped bool and skip charge if true. Pushing patch to billing canary.

dena: Also, telemetry gap: our dashboard aggregates connect events but doesn't show dedupe count. We need a new timeseries 'connects_deduped_total' and a 10s-res sliding count so we can correlate with billing blips.

julie: For alerts: change token_rate alert to ignore spikes that correspond to "connects_deduped_total > 0" within same minute OR require sustained >30s. Safer than suppressing entirely.

nilesh: Deployed router guard to canary slice. Early logs show the second connect returning 204 and router emitting dedupe=true tag.

ingest-bot: Billing-canary: observed registration with deduped=true. billing-service skipped charge.

max: Good sign. Removing on-call paging rule until we validate for 2 hours.

dena: I'll instrument the Console usage panel to show both 'raw connect attempts' and 'accepted sessions' so customers can see suppression. Low-risk UI tweak.

julie: Can we also backfill the last 24h for tenants who saw spikes and apply credits? Not urgent but good CS.

max: Finance needs an estimate of impacted tokens. I can get a CSV from billing-canary logs.

nilesh: Long-term note: this exposed a class of edge-proxy retransmit race. We should add idempotent handshake semantics (client handshake nonce + server ack) and edge-side retransmit handling.

dena: Also consider exposing a small "reconnect-reason" code to customers in Console details so they can see if they had a network path issue vs server dedupe. Helps support.

julie: Thanks team. Action items: nilesh router dedupe (in prod if canary healthy), max billing skip and backfill plan, dena dashboard metric + console annotation, julie to coordinate customer credit and CS note.

nilesh: Marking patch for prod rollout in 1h if canary remains stable.

ingest-bot: Canary health: stable (20m).

max: Canary shows ~95% reduction in duplicate registrations on the slice.

dena: I'll add the new grafana panel and wire an alert that triggers if deduped_connects > 10/s for >5m to catch a real outage (not a one-off).

julie: Filing follow-up RFC to propose handshake nonce protocol. Will link to this thread.

max: PRs: router/4032, billing/991, console/121. Links in #infra-ops later.

dena: Good work. Leaving thread pinned for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
